어떤.forms: 어떤 + noun: 어떤 사람 · 어떤 음식 · from 어떻다
어떤.m: what kind of, what sort of; which; a certain, some
어떤.x: What kind of music do you like?
어떤.e: From 어떻다 (to be how) — same family as 어떻게 (how).
어떤.t: 어떤 asks about qualities ('what is it like?'); 무슨 asks about type or identity.

회사.x: My father works at a company.
회사.e: Literally 'meeting company' — people gathered for business.
회사.t: 회사에 다니다 (lit. 'go to a company') is the usual way to say someone works at a company.

소리.x: There's a strange sound coming from outside.
소리.e: 목소리 = voice (목 throat + 소리 sound); 소리 지르다 = to shout.

이다.forms: 이에요 (after consonant) / 예요 (after vowel) · 이었어요/였어요 · 일 거예요 · 이세요/세요
이다.t: 이다 attaches directly to the noun: 학생이에요, 의사예요. Formal: 학생입니다.

결혼하다.x: My older sister got married last year.
결혼하다.t: 'Marry someone' → 사람하고/와 결혼하다 (not 을/를). 'Are you married?' → 결혼했어요?

거스름돈.x: The convenience store clerk gave me the wrong change.
거스름돈.e: From 거스르다 'to give back change' plus 돈 'money'.
거스름돈.t: In everyday speech, 잔돈 is often used for change too: "잔돈 여기 있어요."

더위.x: The heat this summer is really intense.
더위.e: Noun from 덥다 'hot': the ㅂ softens into 우, giving 더위.
더위.t: 더위를 타다 means 'to be sensitive to heat'; 더위를 먹다 means to get sick from the heat.

오이.x: In summer, I often eat cold cucumber soup.
오이.t: 오이소박이, stuffed cucumber kimchi, is a popular summer side dish.

사촌.x: Every vacation I played with my younger cousin.

그녀.ex: 그녀는 소설 속에서 아주 용감한 사람이에요.
그녀.x: In the novel, she is a very brave person.
그녀.e: 그 'that' + 녀 'woman'; a modern written-style word.
그녀.t: 그녀 is rare in conversation; Koreans usually say 그 사람, 그분, or the person's name.

오해.ex: 친구와 작은 오해가 생겨서 마음이 안 좋아요.
오해.x: I had a small misunderstanding with my friend, so I feel bad.
오해.t: A misunderstanding 'happens' with 오해가 생기다 and is cleared up with 오해를 풀다.

해결하다.ex: 우리 같이 이 문제를 해결해 봐요.
해결하다.x: Let's try to solve this problem together.
해결하다.t: Usually paired with 문제: 문제를 해결하다 'solve a problem'.

금연.x: Smoking is not allowed inside this building.
금연.t: 금연하다 means 'to quit smoking,' while 금연 on a sign means 'No Smoking.'

주민.ex: 이 아파트 주민들은 서로 잘 알아요.
주민.x: The residents of this apartment building know each other well.
주민.e: Literally 'living people': the people who live in a place.

어린이날.x: On Children's Day, people give children presents.
어린이날.e: 어린이 'child' + 날 'day'; it's a public holiday on May 5.

세대.x: Each generation thinks in a slightly different way.
세대.e: Literally 'generation era': the people of one period.

참가.m: participation, entry (in an event or contest)
참가.x: Applications to enter this contest are due by Friday.

권리.ex: 모든 아이는 교육을 받을 권리가 있습니다.
권리.x: Every child has the right to receive an education.
권리.t: Pronounced [궐리]: ㄴ before ㄹ becomes ㄹ. Pattern: V-(으)ㄹ 권리가 있다.

범죄.ex: 이 동네는 범죄가 거의 없어서 안전해요.
범죄.x: This neighborhood is safe because there's almost no crime.
범죄.t: Use 범죄를 저지르다 for 'to commit a crime'; 범인 is the culprit.

늘어나다.m: to increase, to grow, to stretch out
늘어나다.ex: 요즘 자전거를 타는 사람이 많이 늘어났어요.
늘어나다.x: Lately the number of people riding bikes has grown a lot.
늘어나다.e: 늘다 (to increase) + 나다 (to come out): growing outward.

유머.ex: 제 남자 친구는 유머 감각이 있어서 재미있어요.
유머.x: My boyfriend is fun to be with because he has a sense of humor.

가치.ex: 이 그림은 역사적으로 가치가 아주 높아요.
가치.x: This painting has great historical value.
가치.e: Literally 'value and worth' — two syllables with the same meaning.
가치.t: V-(으)ㄹ 가치가 있다 means 'worth doing': 볼 가치가 있어요 'It's worth seeing.'

선호.ex: 요즘 젊은 사람들은 작은 집에 대한 선호가 높아요.
선호.x: Young people these days have a strong preference for small homes.

생활용품.ex: 마트에서 휴지와 세제 같은 생활용품을 샀어요.
생활용품.x: I bought household goods like toilet paper and detergent at the supermarket.
생활용품.t: Pronounced [생활룡품]: an ㄴ sound is added before 용, then it becomes ㄹ.

교훈.ex: 이 이야기는 우리에게 중요한 교훈을 줘요.
교훈.x: This story teaches us an important lesson.
교훈.t: 교훈을 얻다 = to learn a lesson (from an experience).

세관.x: They inspected my bag at customs when I entered the country.

무너지다.x: An old building collapsed in the earthquake.

이상적.x: This house is ideal for a family to live in.
이상적.e: 이상 'ideal' + -적 '-like': -적 turns nouns into '-ic/-al' words: 이상적, 현실적.
이상적.t: Don't confuse with 이상하다 'strange' — that 이상 is a different word with different hanja.

연차.ex: 이번 금요일에 연차를 내고 여행을 가요.
연차.x: I'm taking a day off this Friday and going on a trip.
연차.e: Short for 연차 휴가, literally 'yearly leave'.
연차.t: Say 연차를 내다 or 연차를 쓰다 to take a day off; 반차 is a half day.

주주.x: The company distributed profits to its shareholders.
주주.e: Literally 'share owner' — -주 = owner, as in 광고주.

검소하다.x: He is rich, but he lives very modestly.
검소하다.t: 검소하다 describes a modest, simple lifestyle; 알뜰하다 is about managing money cleverly.

매체.ex: 젊은 사람들은 주로 인터넷 매체로 뉴스를 봐요.
매체.x: Young people mostly get their news through online media.

주입식.ex: 주입식 교육은 학생들의 창의력을 키우기 어려워요.
주입식.x: Rote education makes it hard for students to develop creativity.
주입식.e: Literally 'pour-in style' — stuffing facts into students.
주입식.t: Almost always appears as 주입식 교육 'rote education', usually in criticism.

해커.x: A hacker secretly broke into the bank's system.

인공위성.ex: 인공위성 덕분에 날씨를 정확하게 알 수 있어요.
인공위성.x: Thanks to satellites, we can know the weather accurately.

규제.ex: 정부는 플라스틱 사용에 대한 규제를 강화했어요.
규제.x: The government tightened regulations on plastic use.
규제.t: Pair with 완화 and 강화: 규제를 완화하다 'ease regulations', 규제를 강화하다 'tighten regulations'.

완화.x: The government decided to ease real estate regulations.

무려.m: as many as, no less than, a whopping
무려.ex: 이 영화는 무려 천만 명이 봤어요.
무려.x: A whopping ten million people saw this movie.
무려.t: Emphasizes a surprisingly large number; the opposite feeling is 고작 or 불과.

온전하다.ex: 오래된 그릇이 깨지지 않고 온전하게 남아 있어요.
온전하다.x: The old bowl remains intact without breaking.
온전하다.e: Literally 'calm and whole' — nothing missing, nothing broken.
온전하다.t: Also figurative: 온전히 나만의 시간 (time completely my own).

결함.ex: 그 회사는 자동차 결함 때문에 리콜을 했습니다.
결함.x: The company issued a recall because of car defects.
결함.t: 결함 is for flaws in products or systems; for personal shortcomings, 단점 is more common.

실체.x: The true nature of that company was finally revealed.
실체.e: Literally 'real body': what actually exists behind appearances.

연패.x: That team finally won after ten straight losses.
연패.e: Literally 'defeats in a row.' Homonym warning: another 연패 means consecutive championships.
연패.t: Context decides: '3연패 달성' (achieved) means three straight titles, while '연패에 빠지다' means a losing streak.

애창곡.ex: 노래방에 가면 제 애창곡을 꼭 불러요.
애창곡.x: Whenever I go to karaoke, I always sing my go-to song.
애창곡.e: Literally 'loved singing tune': 애 'love' + 창 'sing' + 곡 'tune'.
애창곡.t: Casually people say 18번 (십팔번) 'my number 18' for the same idea.

유세.ex: 후보들이 시장 앞에서 선거 유세를 하고 있어요.
유세.x: The candidates are giving campaign speeches in front of the market.

인지.ex: 나이가 들면 인지 능력이 조금씩 떨어질 수 있어요.
인지.x: As you age, your cognitive abilities may gradually decline.

테러.ex: 공항에서 테러가 일어나 많은 사람이 다쳤습니다.
테러.x: A terror attack happened at the airport, and many people were injured.
테러.t: Konglish twist: 테러 means 'terrorism/attack'; for the feeling of terror, use 공포.

마찰.ex: 두 나라 사이에 무역 마찰이 계속되고 있습니다.
마찰.x: Trade friction between the two countries is continuing.
마찰.e: Literally 'rubbing and scraping'; like English, it also means social friction.

소재.ex: 이 옷은 가볍고 시원한 소재로 만들었어요.
소재.x: These clothes are made of a light, cool material.
소재.e: Literally 'raw material'; also the 'material' for a story or film.
소재.t: Homonym 소재 所在 means 'whereabouts', as in 소재를 파악하다 'locate someone'.

혈연.ex: 혈연으로 맺어진 사람만 가족인 것은 아니에요.
혈연.x: People tied by blood aren't the only ones who are family.

비준하다.ex: 국회는 그 조약을 압도적인 찬성으로 비준했습니다.
비준하다.x: The National Assembly ratified the treaty by an overwhelming majority.
비준하다.e: Literally 'approve and authorize' — the final sign-off on a treaty.

진부하다.x: The movie's plot was so clichéd that it was boring.
진부하다.t: 진부하다 describes the content itself; 식상하다 means you're sick of seeing it.

빈곤하다.ex: 이 지역에는 아직도 빈곤한 가정이 많아요.
빈곤하다.x: There are still many poor families in this area.
빈곤하다.t: Also figurative: 상상력이 빈곤하다 'to be lacking in imagination'.

허둥지둥.m: in a flurry, in a flustered hurry, helter-skelter
허둥지둥.x: I overslept, so I rushed out of the house in a panic.
허둥지둥.e: Built on 허둥대다 'to flounder, rush about'.

부전자전.x: The son loves soccer just like his dad — like father, like son.
부전자전.e: Literally 'the father passes it down, the son passes it on'.
부전자전.t: For mothers and daughters, people say 모전여전.

촌철살인.m: a pithy remark that hits the mark; a cutting one-liner
촌철살인.x: That writer is famous for razor-sharp, pithy remarks.
촌철살인.e: Literally 'killing a person with an inch of iron' — a tiny blade, a huge effect.
촌철살인.t: It's praise for wit, not violence: 촌철살인의 한마디 'a pithy, spot-on remark.'

대의.ex: 그는 개인의 이익보다 대의를 위해 살았어요.
대의.x: He lived for the greater good rather than his own interests.
대의.t: Homonym 대의 'representation' appears in 대의 민주주의 'representative democracy'.

교육청.m: regional office of education, education office
교육청.x: The office of education announced a new admissions policy.

발을 동동 구르다.forms: 발을 동동 굴러요 · 발을 동동 굴렀어요 (르 irregular)
발을 동동 구르다.m: to be frantic with worry or impatience, to be beside oneself (lit. to stamp one's feet)
발을 동동 구르다.ex: 아이가 전화를 안 받아서 발을 동동 굴렀어요.
발을 동동 구르다.x: My child wasn't answering the phone, so I was frantic with worry.
발을 동동 구르다.e: 동동 imitates quick, light stamping: the restless movement of someone anxious who can do nothing but wait.
발을 동동 구르다.t: 구르다 'to stamp' is 르-irregular: 굴러요, 굴렀어요. For helpless anxiety or urgency, e.g. waiting for news or running late.

누범.m: repeat offense (within the legal period), repeat offender
누범.ex: 누범은 일반적으로 더 무거운 처벌을 받습니다.
누범.x: Repeat offenders generally receive heavier punishment.
누범.t: 재범 is the everyday word for reoffending; 누범 is the legal term for reoffending within three years of a prison sentence.

감금.ex: 범인은 피해자를 며칠 동안 창고에 감금했습니다.
감금.x: The criminal held the victim captive in a warehouse for several days.

호가.ex: 집주인들이 아파트 호가를 계속 올리고 있어요.
호가.x: Owners keep raising the asking prices for their apartments.
호가.e: Literally 'calling out a price' — what the seller asks, not what's finally paid.
호가.t: As 호가하다 it means 'to be priced at': 10억 원을 호가하는 아파트 'an apartment going for a billion won.'

경영권.ex: 두 형제가 회사의 경영권을 두고 다투고 있어요.
경영권.x: Two brothers are fighting over control of the company.
경영권.e: 경영 'management' + -권 'right, power,' a productive suffix: 인권, 투표권.
경영권.t: Pronounced [경영꿘]; 경영권 분쟁 'a fight for control' is a common headline phrase.

사모펀드.x: A private equity fund acquired the company.
사모펀드.e: 사모 'privately recruited' + English 'fund': money raised from a few investors.
사모펀드.t: Its opposite is 공모펀드, a fund openly sold to the general public.

권한위임.ex: 효율적인 업무를 위해서는 적절한 권한위임이 필요해요.
권한위임.x: Proper delegation of authority is needed for efficient work.
권한위임.e: Literally 'entrusting one's powers' to someone else.
권한위임.t: The verb form is 권한을 위임하다 (to delegate authority to someone).

규제완화.ex: 정부는 기업 투자를 늘리기 위해 규제완화를 추진하고 있어요.
규제완화.x: The government is pushing deregulation to increase corporate investment.

세력균형.x: The balance of power in Northeast Asia is changing rapidly.

전범.ex: 그는 전쟁이 끝난 후 전범으로 재판을 받았습니다.
전범.x: He was tried as a war criminal after the war ended.
전범.t: Koreans call Japan's Rising Sun flag 전범기 'war criminal flag'.

천륜.m: natural bond of kinship, blood ties
천륜.ex: 부모와 자식 사이의 천륜은 끊을 수 없어요.
천륜.x: The natural bond between parents and children cannot be broken.
천륜.e: Literally 'heaven's order': family ties no one chooses.
천륜.t: Pronounced [철륜]: ㄴ before ㄹ becomes ㄹ.

소견.x: In the doctor's opinion, surgery isn't necessary.

유망산업.x: AI is considered a leading promising industry of the future.
유망산업.t: 유망 also describes people: 유망한 선수 'a promising athlete.'

초연.x: This opera premiered in Rome in 1900.
초연.e: Literally 'first performance'. Homonym alert: 초연하다 also means 'to be aloof, detached'.
초연.t: Often used as a verb: 초연되다 (to be premiered), 세계 초연 (world premiere).

유구하다.x: Korea is a country with a long history.

단죄하다.x: History will condemn the dictator's crimes.
단죄하다.e: Literally 'judge a crime': passing a guilty sentence, legally or morally.

흐느끼다.ex: 그녀는 편지를 읽고 어깨를 들썩이며 조용히 흐느꼈어요.
흐느끼다.x: After reading the letter, she sobbed quietly, her shoulders shaking.
흐느끼다.t: 흐느끼다 is quiet, shaking sobs; loud crying is 엉엉 울다.

음울하다.ex: 비가 계속 와서 거리 분위기가 음울해요.
음울하다.x: It keeps raining, so the mood on the streets is gloomy.

거두절미.m: cutting to the chase, skipping the preamble
거두절미.x: We're short on time, so I'll cut to the chase and give you the conclusion first.
거두절미.e: Literally 'remove the head, cut off the tail', leaving only the core.
거두절미.t: Very common as 거두절미하고 at the start of a sentence.

소멸시효.x: The statute of limitations on that claim has already run out.
소멸시효.e: Literally 'time limit after which a right disappears.'
소멸시효.t: Collocates with 지나다 or 완성되다: 소멸시효가 완성되다 'the limitation period expires.'
